NICEIC Domestic Installer

NICEIC Registered for Your Peace of Mind

NICEIC is a UK certification body for electrical businesses. It assesses and certifies businesses against technical standards and industry requirements, helping customers identify contractors whose work and business systems have been independently assessed.

APM Electrical Services is registered on the NICEIC Domestic Installer Scheme. This scheme is designed for businesses carrying out domestic electrical installation work and enables certified businesses to register applicable work in accordance with Part P of the Building Regulations.

NICEIC-certified businesses are subject to assessment against relevant technical standards.
The Domestic Installer Scheme covers domestic electrical installation work and Part P notifiable installations.
Customers can check NICEIC-certified businesses using NICEIC’s official Find a Trusted Tradesperson service.
Learn more at NICEIC

Meet your electrician

About Adam

I’m Adam, the electrician behind APM Electrical Services. I left school in 2010 and went straight into an electrical apprenticeship, giving me the opportunity to learn the trade from the ground up.

Since qualifying, I’ve developed not only my electrical skills but also the importance of working and communicating directly with customers. I take the time to understand what you need, discuss the options clearly and provide an honest, approachable service.

For me, one of the most rewarding parts of the job is providing a good service and seeing a customer happy with the finished result. I take pride in understanding what each customer needs, carrying out the work professionally and leaving them with a result they’re satisfied with.

I enjoy the problem-solving side of electrical work too. Whether it’s tracking down a fault or finding the right solution for a particular requirement, I aim to provide practical, straightforward solutions and a professional service from start to finish.

AM

A personal service

When you contact APM Electrical Services, you’re dealing directly with Adam — from discussing the work and understanding your requirements through to carrying out the installation.
